about: Editorial calls from Afronomics Receipts, written when each Receipt is published and graded against the source each call names. Never edited: a correction is a new call. The outcome is the published figure, with its source and quote.

calls.statement: The offer clears its 75% minimum and the shares list on 12 November 2026
calls.measure: Shares listed on the NSE on 12 November 2026

calls.statement: Total demand comes in below 150% of the shares on offer
calls.measure: Total demand, % of the shares on offer

calls.statement: The shares close their first trading day within 10% of KES 7.50
Profit for 2026 comes in below the KES 2.1 billion forecast

The shares are listed on the Nigerian Exchange by 18 December 2026
calls.measure: Shares listed on the NGX by 18 December 2026

calls.statement: The receipts start trading on the NSE by 31 December 2026
calls.measure: Dangote GDRs trading on the NSE by 31 December 2026

calls.statement: Profit for 2026 comes in below US$3.64 billion, twice the first half
Kenya's 2031 Eurobond yields less than 9% on 31 March 2027
calls.measure: Yield on Kenya's 2031 Eurobond for 31 March 2027, CBK Weekly Bulletin Table 6
calls.check_source: CBK Weekly Bulletin, Table 6 (Afronomics Eurobond file)

calls.statement: Kenya's 2031 Eurobond still yields more than Nigeria's January 2031 Eurobond on 31 March 2027
calls.measure: Kenya 2031 yield minus Nigeria 8.747% January 2031 yield on 31 March 2027, in points
calls.check_source: CBK Weekly Bulletin Table 6 and Nigeria DMO daily Eurobond prices (Afronomics Eurobond file)

calls.statement: Kenya pays the 16 February 2027 coupon on the 2031 notes, US$73.125 million, on the due date
calls.measure: 16 February 2027 coupon on the 9.750% notes due 2031 paid on the due date
calls.check_source: National Treasury, monthly public debt bulletin for February 2027

calls.statement: Kenya's next new dollar Eurobond carries a coupon below the 9.75% of the 2031 notes
calls.measure: Coupon of the first new Kenya US-dollar Eurobond priced between 15 October 2026 and 30 June 2027 (void if none is priced)

calls.statement: No infrastructure bond, new or reopened, clears at a weighted average rate above 15% at any auction before 30 June 2027
calls.measure: Highest weighted average rate accepted at any IFB auction, 16 October 2026 to 30 June 2027
calls.check_source: CBK Treasury bond auction results (Afronomics bond auction file)

calls.statement: The 364-day Treasury bill clears below 10% at the last auction of June 2027
calls.measure: 364-day bill weighted average rate, last auction with a value date in June 2027
calls.check_source: CBK Treasury bill auction results (Afronomics auction file)

calls.statement: Any new infrastructure bond issued before 31 December 2027 carries a coupon below 14%
calls.measure: Highest coupon on a new IFB issued between 16 October 2026 and 31 December 2027
calls.check_source: CBK Treasury bond auction results (Afronomics bond auction file)
